name: Being Tested
overview: Scripture reveals that being tested is a purposeful act of God to refine and prove the believer’s faith and character, much like silver and gold are purified through fire (Psalms 66:10; Proverbs 17:3; Job 23:10). God’s testing is not arbitrary but is accompanied by His presence, strength, and protection, as He upholds and strengthens His people in their trials (Isaiah 41:10; Proverbs 3:26). The example of Abraham’s willingness to respond faithfully when tested (Genesis 22:1) highlights the believer’s call to trust and obedience amidst divine examination.
